problem.title: ELO KITTI Odom seq 07 full: comparison with the paper's KITTI table
problem.question: How close is the ELO reimplementation to the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry translational error (official RTE)?

variants.label: ELO, CPU fast profile (1024x80 SRI, 0.3 m BEV)
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).
variants.note: ELO: frame-to-model projective odometry with non-ground spherical range-image map, ground BEV map, range-adaptive PCA normals, and SRI/BEV model fusion; CV prior, no GT seed. mean|residual|=0.026 g=5103 ng=461
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: ELO dense profile + 0.195 deg correction + the paper's normal patch size
variants.intent: The two paper mechanics that help on seq 07: the 0.195 deg vertical-angle correction the paper applies (Sec. IV-A) and the range-adaptive normal patch read as the full patch size (eq. 12; the default uses it as the half-width).
variants.note: ELO: frame-to-model projective odometry with non-ground spherical range-image map, ground BEV map, range-adaptive PCA normals, and SRI/BEV model fusion; CV prior, no GT seed. mean|residual|=0.026 g=8396 ng=7405 w=0.00
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Close enough to the current default to keep as a live alternative.

variants.label: ELO paper profile (all paper mechanics as read) + 0.195 deg correction
variants.intent: Raw scans, count-normalised fusion w = 0.7 w2, two-sided ground test, full-size normal patch, 0.1 m single-vertex BEV, single-pixel association, plain Gauss-Newton; worse than the selective variant on seq 07 (see papers/elo/README.md).

variants.label: ELO dense profile + 0.195 deg correction + paper normal patch + forward-bias fixes
variants.intent: On top of dense_elevation_paper_normals: same-surface fusion in the closest-point SRI update (repeated minimum ranges made model surfaces creep towards the sensor), no forward (x) term from the noisy BEV ground normals, and a stricter curvature threshold (0.03) against convex-surface bias. Chosen on KITTI 07 windows, 00 held out (see papers/elo/README.md).
variants.note: ELO: frame-to-model projective odometry with non-ground spherical range-image map, ground BEV map, range-adaptive PCA normals, and SRI/BEV model fusion; CV prior, no GT seed. mean|residual|=0.022 g=9139 ng=4578 w=0.00
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
